# dspc_block_storage_attachment (Data Source)

Retrieves a specific block storage attachment in the DSPC platform.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `block_storage_name` (String) The name of the block storage.
- `vm_name` (String) The name of the virtual machine.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier for the block storage attachment.
